decisions.statement: Attention counts where that attention made that part of Alan's life better.
Attention counts the same from every worker.
The stoplight built from a persona's points prompts Alan.
A persona's daily points and her running total read the same source.
For some sources a persona's running total is the sum of her days.
A persona's running total only ever rises.
A rebuild rewrites a persona's running total downward.
A day's color is computed rather than stored.
A stored day agrees with the points its recipe computes.
A persona's points compute the same wherever the command is run from.
Nothing tells Alan a persona has no figure while something else shows Alan one.
No figure Alan reads is arrived at by counting files in a directory.
Every persona under a value can move that value's light.

definition: a measure of the attention Alan gave one part of his life
